about: Loading screens: a painted how-to-play slide per topic, with its own title and facts listed under it, and the truck's wheel spinning on a mud mound at the bottom left, throwing mud. Encoded small (width, quality), cropped where noted (crop = left, top, right, bottom in source pixels), because they must show at once. The PNGs in source/ are the masters; source/prompts.json records how they were made.

bog.title: Deep mud
facts: Drop to L before you reach the bog, not once you are stuck in it.
AWD drives every axle. DIFF LOCK turns all the wheels together, so one spinning tire cannot waste the power.
Light trucks can wiggle through. A loaded rig may need its breakdown truck.

winch.title: Breakdown truck
facts: Call it from the top bar, once per run. It comes from the start of the trail.
Back it within 5 m of the stuck truck and tap WINCH to hook on.
Drive away to tow. The cable never reels in, and the breakdown truck never gets stuck.

fuel.title: Fuel stations
facts: Stop in a station's bay to refuel and repair.
The trip line shows how far away the next station is.
Run the tank dry and the engine stops. The breakdown truck can tow you in.

obstacles.title: Logs, rocks and pipes
facts: Big tires climb pipes and logs. Small ones hang up on them.
Take them slowly in L, so the tires can grip and climb.
Hard hits add damage. A fuel station repairs it.

coins.title: Coins
facts: New ground, things you crush and deep bogs you clear all pay.
Spend coins in the garage on tuning and powers.

garage.title: Garage tuning
facts: Each truck has four knobs: engine, suspension, speed and grip.
Upgrades are saved per truck, and selling a step back refunds it.
Pick one power per truck: Invincible, Nitro or Instant brakes.
